en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a small Catholic chapel with wooden pews, an ornate altar with statues and candles, and religious wall paintings. The lower front caption identifies the location as in Pécs and describes it as the chapel of the episcopal seminary. The reverse side is blank except for printer information and dividing lines for address and message.
